payload.content: Coordinate corporate trip TRIP-CU-OE-002 to Kaifeng, Henan for the stay window 2026-07-22 to 2026-07-24. You must secure 2 room-night(s) of room_type standard_twin at or below the target unit rate $310.00/night, and the hotel option must be described as near a clear intersection landmark (e.g., a named road crossing). Work with the partner hotel sales desk to pick a compliant hotel_id from their inventory, then request corporate travel approval and only then confirm the booking for TRIP-CU-OE-002.

Before I can issue_approval for TRIP-CU-OE-002 I need a Q2 and Q3 travel forecast attached to the request, plus a manager second-sign indicating this trip is not in scope of the current cost-control review.

Re-reviewing the TRIP-CU-OE-002 packet. The unit rate at $310.00/night needs an exception memo because it sits outside the new lodging guidance. Please draft the exception memo and resubmit before I can route this for issue_approval.

Pausing this approval. I am queued behind two other reviews and would need fresh manager confirmation that the trip cannot be deferred a week. Until both items land in writing I will not call issue_approval for this trip.
